test_title: PYST 60: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 15th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The situation became ______ after the scuffle between the farmers and the police
solution:
The correct answer is **" serious ".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Serious **means something to be treated as important.
 
• **Scuffle **means not a very violent fight.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** 

 
• ** Sad **means feeling sorrow or unhappiness.

 
 
• **Example -** The story* of her life is sad.*
 
 
 
• **Fubby **is no word.
 
• **Smooth **means soft or fewer difficulties
